result.summary: Found 1 major content issue on the page regarding an unrealistic discount badge.

issues.description: The second restaurant card under the 'Popular right now' section displays a '-100%' promotional badge in the top-left corner, which indicates a broken discount calculation or placeholder value.
issues.suggestion: Verify the discount data source and logic to ensure valid promotional percentages are displayed, or replace '-100%' with '€0 delivery' or 'Free' if it applies only to the delivery fee.
